text: Ekadashi, the eleventh day, was set aside by our elders as a special time to turn our attention inward.
It was a day to gently shift focus away from worldly appetites and towards remembrance.
The true essence of this day was never about an empty stomach; rather, it was about the quiet space it created within us for deeper connection.
Today, as you go about your day, you might like to chant 'Om Namo Narayanaya' quietly while doing your ordinary work.
Alternatively, you could read a few names from the Vishnu Sahasranamam.
In the evening, light a deepam and simply take one still minute in its gentle glow.
